lines.text: # Comprehende

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/comprehende)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/comprehende)

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Comprehende groups a git diff by review concern and shows the groups in a local web UI. Your coding agent writes the summaries. The diff always comes from git in your repository, never from the model, and the review file never stores it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Install

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: npx skills add matemolnar8/comprehende

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Requires Node.js 24+ and git.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Use

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Inside the repository you want to review, run `/comprehende` in your coding agent. Name what to review: a pull request, a branch, or the changes from the last turn. The agent writes a review file and prints a local URL for the UI.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: When the branch gets new commits, run it again. The agent keeps the existing groups and rewrites only the ones that changed.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Why

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: AI coding agents write more code than we can read line by line. Three ideas explain the risk.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Cognitive offloading means you give a tool the _how_ and keep the _why_ and the _what_. A calculator adds two numbers, but you chose the numbers and you know why you need the sum.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Cognitive surrender means you stop forming your own answer and take the tool's answer, with nothing of your own to compare it to. The calculator picks the numbers too, and you accept the result.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Comprehension debt is the gap between the code in a system and how much of it its developers and operators understand. It is like technical debt with two differences. Nobody chooses to take it on, and nobody sees it. The tests pass and the code looks clean, so nobody knows where the debt is until something breaks.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Each time we accept agent code without reading it, we surrender and the debt grows. It comes due at the worst time, during an incident or a long debug session.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Comprehende moves review from surrender back to offloading. You keep the speed of the agents and still understand what they changed.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## CLI

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The skill runs these commands for you. Run them inside the repository under review.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Command                                                          | What it does                                                                                                                             |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | `comprehende review [--base <ref>] [--head <ref>] --data <file>` | Writes a review skeleton for `base...head` with one entry per changed file. The base defaults to `origin/HEAD`, then `main` or `master`. |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | `comprehende digest --base <ref> --head <ref>`                   | Prints one line per changed file: kind, hunks, and symbols.                                                                              |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | `comprehende show --hunk <path@oldStart+newStart>`               | Prints the patch for one hunk or file.                                                                                                   |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | `comprehende pregroup --base <ref> --head <ref> --data <file>`   | Writes a draft review that already groups identical copies and mechanical files.                                                         |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | `comprehende validate --data <file>`                             | Checks that every hunk ref points into live git and that every hunk is in a group.                                                       |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | `comprehende serve --data <file>`                                | Serves the UI on a local URL.                                                                                                            |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | `comprehende export --data <file> --out <dir>`                   | Writes a static copy of the UI that any static file server can host.                                                                     |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | `comprehende refresh --data <file>`                              | Moves a review to new commits. Keeps unchanged hunks in their groups and puts new hunks in a draft group.                                |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The URL hash holds the UI location, so a shared link opens the same view in `serve` and `export`.
